data.name: Veeru
data.gender_notes: Veeru is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Veeru is a Hindi and Sanskrit name that means brave, valiant, fearless, and heroic. It is a name that inspires strength and courage, and is often given to boys who are expected to display these traits throughout their lives. The name Veeru carries the meaning “Brave, Valiant, Fearless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Veeru usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, valiant, fearless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Veeru is a name that represents the inner strength and courage that is needed to overcome challenges and obstacles in life. It is a reminder that no matter how difficult the journey may be, one can always find the inner strength to persevere and succeed.
data.etymology: Veeru belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Valiant, Fearless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Veeru total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
